tray.label: Tray icon and system-wide shortcut
tray.hint: The Second Brain icon in the taskbar corner opens the app, captures a note or quits. Ctrl+Alt+Q opens quick capture even while you are in another app.
tray.running: Running. Press Ctrl+Alt+Q anywhere to capture a note to Inbox.
tray.hotkeyTaken: Another app already uses Ctrl+Alt+Q. The tray icon still works: right-click it and choose Quick capture.
tray.off: Off. Turn it on for the tray icon and Ctrl+Alt+Q.
tray.failed: The tray icon stopped several times, so the app paused restarting it. Turn this switch off and on to try again.

install.label: How the app runs
install.sourceHint: To use a single .exe file: double-click "Tạo bản exe" in the app\launcher folder.
install.smartScreen: The first time you open the .exe, Windows may say "Windows protected your PC". Click "More info", then "Run anyway" (the file is not signed).
install.shortcutsHint: Puts a Second Brain shortcut on the desktop and in the Start menu.
install.shortcutsDone: Recreated the shortcuts on the desktop and in the Start menu.
install.shortcutsFailed: Windows did not let the app create the shortcuts. Try again, or make a shortcut to the .exe by hand.
